sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/348 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 348, search/grid facilities 427 'Loops A, B, C', 428 'Loops D, E, F', 426 'Loop G', 429 'Loops H, I, J, K, L' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites 019 and 043 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Every site is electric: $39 a night, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027); off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) both $35 (no water in winter, so full-hookup sites in Loop C rent at the electric rate). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. Campground vehicle/visitor passes are $3 from the Tuesday before Memorial Day through Labor Day and on special-event weekends. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all East Fork campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Fee 6.50); sites 019 and 043 on Sat 2027-06-19 (39.00 / 52.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (35.00 / 35.00) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-fork-state-park-campground ('Campground Vehicle/Visitor Passes are $3; this fee is in effect the Tuesday before Memorial Day through Labor Day, and for Special Event Weekends'; 'no water will be available and therefore the rates are the same as the regular electric sites during witner season'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-fork-state-park-campground ('376 electric sites, 23 full-hookup sites, 17 equestrian sites. All sites have 20-, 30-, and 50-amp service.') + ReserveOhio search/details (every campsite Electricity Hookup '20/30/50 Amp'; the 23 full-hookup sites list Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 385 web-bookable RV sites (362 electric, 23 full hookup) on paved pads, back-in, rated for camping units 37-53 ft (most 44-48), plus 17 electric equestrian sites (1-17, Loop A). ODNR counts 416 sites (376 electric, 23 full hookup, 17 equestrian); no non-electric sites. Limit 6 people, 2 vehicles and 2 pets per site.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (427: 89 units, 428: 91, 426: 99, 429: 124, incl. 1 shelter) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In' or 'Not Applicable', Maximum Camping Unit Length 37-53, equestrian 45-56) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-fork-state-park-campground ('416 comfortable sites', 'Each site has a paved pad', 'Non-electric sites are NOT available in the campground', 'Limit of 6 people per site', '2 vehicles per site', 'Limit of 2 pets per site'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and drinking water in peak season; off-season facilities are limited (Loop C's heated shower house stays open; potable water at the dump station). Campers-only beach and boat ramp for registered campground guests; nature center temporarily closed for updates.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-fork-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, and drinking water during peak season; during non-peak season, facilities and sites are limited.'; 'Camp store in season'; 'Dump station'; 'Boat ramp for registered campground guests'; 'Potable water is available to registered campers at the dump station area.'; Nature Center 'Temporarily closed for updates'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: In winter only Loop C (sites 42-91, heated shower house) and the equestrian Loop A (sites 1-17) stay open; the campground office is closed.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-fork-state-park-campground ('This large and mostly shady year-round campground'; 'Loop C, which is sites 42 through 91, remains open all year round and has a heated shower house'; 'Loop A, which houses our equestrian sites 1 through 17, remains open as well'; 'The Campground Office will NOT be open') + ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12 (427: 67 units free; 428, 426, 429: all blocked), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reserve up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727; no walk-in sites, but when the camp store is open and sites are free a reservation can be made there. 14 nights in any 30-day period. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/east-fork-state-park-campground ('Reservations can be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.'; 'We no longer have "walk-in" camp sites. If the camp store is open and sites are available, a reservation can be made at the camp store.'; 'Limit of 2 weeks stay in a 30-day period at any Ohio State Park'; 'Check-in at 3pm. Check-out at 1pm') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($39 base, full hookup +$13) and added the $35 off-peak rate and the $3 summer vehicle/visitor pass. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at the 23 full-hookup sites, 385 back-in paved RV sites rated to 53 ft (plus 17 equestrian), showers/flush toilets/water/dump/camp store, year-round (Loop C and equestrian Loop A in winter), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, no walk-ins, 14-night max. Pin 1.56 km from the sites' centroid. Not stated: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (513) 724-6521 (camp store / campground); the park office is (513) 734-2730 in Bethel, on the other side of the lake.

Pin 1,562 m off (796 m from the nearest site; it sits west of the campground's northwest corner). Centroid of ReserveOhio's 403 campsite coordinates: 39.03506,-84.09605. ODNR: use the campground's address, 2837 Old SR 32, Batavia, for GPS, not the Bethel administrative office.
